name: templates_by_id
note: ProductTemplate (addons/product/models/product_template.py): every template with its category, type, sale/purchase flags, storable flag and active flag as the ORM reads them (active_test off)
source_sql: SELECT id, categ_id, type, sale_ok, purchase_ok, is_storable, company_id, active FROM product_template ORDER BY id

name: templates_per_category
note: product.category.product_count (addons/product/models/product_category.py) read path: templates per category with the active and saleable counts; templates without a category excluded on both sides
source_sql: SELECT categ_id, count(*) AS templates, count(*) FILTER (WHERE active) AS active_templates, count(*) FILTER (WHERE sale_ok) AS saleable FROM product_template WHERE categ_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY categ_id ORDER BY categ_id
